summary: The hosts discuss Bitcoin consolidating at range highs around 104k after a 40% rally, viewing this as healthy price action with the monthly chart looking 'hilariously bullish'. Ethereum is at a critical inflection point at 2.7k resistance - if broken, they see a clear path to 4k and new ATH. Duck holds spot ETH having stomached a 50% drawdown. They express significant concern about MicroStrategy copycat behavior creating bubble dynamics that will eventually unwind violently, though timing is uncertain. Altcoins are largely consolidating alongside BTC, with ETH-related plays like AAVE outperforming.
key_takeaways: BTC consolidation at 104k is bullish - bears need to break 96-97k to regain control, 99k is early warning for bulls
ETH at critical 2.7k resistance - must break here or bears get validated. 2.2k is the must-hold level for any pullback
Duck is long spot ETH from higher levels, now at break-even, targeting 4k+ if resistance breaks
MicroStrategy copycat bubble is forming - will end badly for late entrants but timing unclear
Low time frame trading at resistance is a trap - wait for daily/weekly confirmation before breakout trades
